text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list:
I made the schedule pretty tough, are you 
gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm tired, but I feel great. I really 
feel like I've made some solid progress.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If we keep going like this, this promising 
feeling will surely become something 
tangible.
choice_data_list: That's a goal for after tomorrow.
That's a goal for after tomorrow, huh.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You're right— Oh? Isn't that Universe over 
there?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Landing Success." Neo Universe engraves 
it. A sign of evolution. A "giant leap" 
inscribed upon the moon—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However... the "course" remains uncertain. 
What is required is "resonance." Mayday, 
mayday...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list:
Her words are as hard to understand as 
always...

Her words are as hard to understand as 
ever...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, I can feel it. Universe's 
"feelings"...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"It's just a feeling, but... I think Ms. 
Universe wants to feel a sense of reality, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just like me. If only the two of us could 
run together like that...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I might grow enough to reach all the way 
into outer space. I have a feeling about 
it."
choice_data_list:
If my body is exhausted, I might get 
stranded...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Universe-saaan! Care to run with me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though not quite to outer space, the two 
continued their joyful run together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, trying to keep up with 
Universe-san in my current condition might 
be a bit reckless."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall rest my body for 
today. Please feel free to call on me once 
I am feeling better.
